Recovery path re-sends full ticket context per criterion (up to 440 requests for 22 criteria with 20-request budget), causing context bloat and resource exhaustion.
Flat 100K-char context ceiling in completion_recovery.py:68 rejects valid live cases (121K-char c9f7 with 22 criteria) and violates no-elision invariant from d59e.
Identical tool-call loops repeat read-only operations without memoization (144x repetition observed), exhausting budget and request quotas within single runs.
Context pre-loading can reduce agentic read round-trips by covering 67-82% of distinct file reads via ranked file_impact contents under budget clamp.
